styleLock.direction: faceless street-style relaxed womens apparel commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio paper white #FFFFFF for the on-body packshot, the colorway row and the three detail cards, flat pale dusty-rose paper #EFE2DF for the benefit hero and the overhead spec screen, washed black #262322 fields for the pain-point split, the macro band and the collage margin, muted mauve-grey #B9A7AC only as the outer frame behind the detail cards; flat low-contrast surfaces, no gradient, no storefront lettering

styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama for on-body screens, matte dusty-rose paper counter for the overhead flat spec screen, plain washed black board behind the macro crops
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, one headline plus at most three short callouts, hairline leader rules, never dense body copy

styleLock.presentationRules: the worn piece always shows the ribbed crew neckline, both wide short sleeve hems, the drop-shoulder seam and the curved long-line hem; on-body screens crop the body above the collarbone or turn it away so no face is ever carried; garment scale and the wearing angle stay stable across the set
noDrift: no identifiable model face or celebrity likeness

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent faceless street-style relaxed womens apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, pale dusty-rose paper #EFE2DF, muted mauve-grey #B9A7AC and washed black #262322; neutral daylight-balanced studio lighting around 5500K with a large front-left softbox key, a bounce fill on the shadow side and soft low-contrast contact shadows that always ground the garment; matte seamless paper cyclorama and flat dusty-rose paper fields only, no gradient and no storefront lettering; modern geometric sans-serif with hairline leader rules and never dense body copy; thin single-weight line icon style; every on-body screen cropped above the collarbone or turned away so no face is carried, with the neckline, both wide short sleeve hems, the drop-shoulder seam and the curved hem always readable; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 为五位模特各穿同款不同纯色按对角叠列排布的白底图（1024x1024 正方，头部在鼻骨以上裁切）；02 为模特穿水洗黑宽松短袖配浅色多袋裤、胯部顶出的竖幅棚拍；03 为模特穿藕灰粉宽松短袖配黑色紧身打底短裤、一手提出下摆的竖幅正面图；04 为三段等高分格拼图，分别拍圆领、宽松落肩短袖与手拉下摆回弹，标签下有浅灰紫短下划线、外框为藕粉调（750x1000）；05 为上半部沙发场景叠六列尺码表（含英寸与厘米两行具体数字）、下半部模特正面全身配三枚洗涤护理图形与英文说明；06 为四格斜切缝穿搭拼贴（厨房中岛、店前、咖啡座、花街），左上与右下有粗体英文标题。品类判定依据：全部图为女式外穿的落肩宽松圆领短袖上衣，按图判为女装/上衣，leaf 取到女式落肩宽松圆领短袖T恤多件装；源挂类目仅作线索未采信，多件装属性由 01 的五色叠列与 02/03 的同款异色上身共同支撑。变体闸门结论：六图中仅 01 属多色叠列陈列，02 至 06 为五种互不相同的构图与分镜（离身上身主图、正侧廓形、三格结构细节、尺码与洗护信息图、场合拼贴），具备独立可复用分镜体系，故不判为变体画廊，正常转化。已剥离内容：原店铺与品牌字标、吊牌与领标字样、五位模特身份与面容（一律改为鼻骨或领骨以上裁切的无面部 generic body）、04 的三行英文标签、05 的尺码数字与洗涤温度与漂白烘干说明、06 的英文标题原句、原平台店铺字样、任何平台徽章与星条角标；克重、成分比例、弹性等级与尺码数据等事实一律不写入，改以空白表格单元、空参数行、空白护理图形框与留空引线槽承载。
